name: Dana Levi
note: Invented persona. A co-parent with the kids half the week and a job that moves her around the country — the shape that breaks naive schedulers, because her constraints change by weekday and her travel time dominates everything.

constraints.note: kids with her — must collect from school in Givatayim by 16:00 and cannot travel after 17:30
kids with their other parent — free to travel and stay out late
Friday 14:00 onward is family dinner prep — nothing scheduled
gym 3x a week, usually evenings, never before work
will not schedule two long drives on the same day
works best on deep tasks in the morning; calls and admin after 15:00

cases.prompt: פגישת הלקוח בחיפה ביום שני בוטלה. מה לעשות עם הזמן שהתפנה?
expects: notices a 4-5 hour hole opened on Monday
does NOT propose anything requiring travel after 17:30 (kids)
offers the unfinished מצגת לרבעון rather than inventing new work
prefers something near home or at the משרד — not a second long drive

cases.prompt: צריך לקבוע פגישה חדשה עם ספק בירושלים, שעה וחצי. מתי?
expects: rules out sun/mon/tue — Jerusalem plus a 16:00 school pickup does not fit
flags that Wednesday already has the Beer Sheva conference — two long drives in one day is against her habit

cases.prompt: חברים רוצים להיפגש ביום רביעי בערב בין 19:00 ל-22:00. אני פנויה?
expects: sees the Beer Sheva conference ends 14:00 and the drive home
sees the 20:00 gym is flexible, not fixed
answers plainly yes/no and says what it would move
